description: Systematic inventory of qualified evidence sources for Commander Studio (P0 Deliverable 1).

sources.title: Scryfall Bulk Manifest & Oracle Cards
sources.observation_period: All released MTG sets through November 2026
sources.coverage_scope: 100% of all MTG cards; has_scryfall_facts 927 / 927 pool cards (gap matrix data/research/chulane_legal_pool_gap_matrix.json, generated 2026-11-12)
sources.double_counting_risk: None; cards fold strictly 1:1 to canonical oracle_id across printings.
sources.license_terms: Scryfall API Terms: free personal / non-commercial use with fan content attribution; no AI training.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Bulk GET (daily manifest, conditional ETag requests; generic User-Agent and Accept headers required; strip price fields on write into scryfall_card; only for the TAM purchase view (#1637) the fields prices.eur, prices.eur_foil and cardmarket_id of a local bulk file go into the local store table tam_price_eur and its companion table, never committed; no single-card polling loop).
bias_risks: Facts and mechanics, no evaluation of gameplay strength or deck fit
Scryfall Tagger roles are subjective community classifications and not authoritative Oracle facts
sources.status_rationale: Fully verified daily bulk dataset imported into studio.sqlite3 (scryfall_card, 35,353 cards); covers 927 / 927 pool cards of the gap matrix generated 2026-11-12 (pool size at other dates: unbekannt).

sources.title: Playgroup.gg Card Atlas & Gameplay Research
sources.coverage_scope: Subset of cards actively cast in Playgroup Live games
sources.double_counting_risk: Pod clustering: repeated games by the same local playgroups skew frequencies; paper games tracked without digital card logging lack card events.
sources.license_terms: Licence status ungeklärt, no legal review (docs/research/data_wave1_20261118/README.md section 4): the public OpenAPI description states CC BY 4.0 for aggregated statistics with attribution and link and permits bulk access; authenticated raw-games endpoint excluded.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Public API / HTML GET with recognizable generic User-Agent (400 req/min with UA, 10 req/min without; max 20 requests/10 min per commander path; respect 429 Retry-After; attribution with link requested; the CC BY 4.0 licence claim is ungeklärt, no legal review).
bias_risks: Observed correlations are NOT causal proof of card efficacy
Survivorship bias: drawn-to-played measures only cards drawn in surviving game states
Pilot- and pod-clustering bias
Missing long-tail coverage: cards with few live appearances remain completely unobserved
sources.status_rationale: The public OpenAPI description permits bulk access with a generic User-Agent (licence CC BY 4.0 stated there, ungeklärt, no legal review); Card Atlas itself is HTML (/cards/...) with survivorship and pod-clustering biases, so data quality remains REVIEW.

sources.title: Playgroup.gg Chulane Commander Performance
sources.observation_period: Aggregated live games, manual page inspection with state per the Phase-7 spec dated 2026-11-08 (2,094 recorded games, provider figure, not recounted)
sources.schema_format: Public REST API / HTML Web Page
sources.coverage_scope: Chulane cards with sufficient live appearances in Playgroup Live
sources.double_counting_risk: Repeated matches of the same deck/pilot combination in a recurring playgroup.
sources.license_terms: Licence status ungeklärt, no legal review (docs/research/data_wave1_20261118/README.md section 4): the public OpenAPI description states CC BY 4.0 for aggregated commander statistics with attribution and link and permits bulk access.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Public API GET with recognizable generic User-Agent (400 req/min with UA, 10 req/min without; max 20 requests/10 min per commander path; respect 429 Retry-After; attribution with link requested; the CC BY 4.0 licence claim is ungeklärt, no legal review).
bias_risks: Seat position skew (state 2026-11-08, provider figures): seat 1 45.3% in 674 games, seat 5 16.3% in 43 games (seats 5 and 6 were locked for Studio play until the Owner released them on 2026-11-22, register E16)
Archetype skew: Playgroup Chulane population is heavily Landfall-focused
Small sample sizes for non-staple cards (n < 30)
sources.status_rationale: The public OpenAPI description permits bulk access with a generic User-Agent (licence CC BY 4.0 stated there, ungeklärt, no legal review). Provider-published Chulane win rate 36% (770 wins, 1,304 losses, 2,094 recorded games; the figures do not reconcile to one denominator, state per the Phase-7 spec dated 2026-11-08). Other counting methods, never mixed with it: data wave 1 commander list 449 / 1,111 rated seats (40.4%, retrieved 2026-11-18) and per-commander CSV 782 / 2,110 games (37%, retrieved 2026-11-11/12). Winrate and card lifts remain REVIEW due to heavy pilot, seat-position, and archetype confounding.

sources.title: EDHREC Chulane Recommendations & Relative Lift
sources.observation_period: Two-year rolling window of online decklists (Archidekt, Moxfield)
sources.coverage_scope: Top ~1,300 cards appearing in online Chulane decks; long-tail (<1%) omitted
sources.double_counting_risk: Thematic and budget subviews overlap with the main commander page; must never be summed across cohorts.
sources.license_terms: EDHREC Terms of Service (effective 2024-08-06): personal non-commercial viewing only; automated queries, scripts, and downloading are prohibited; robots.txt disallows /deckpreview/.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: PROHIBITED_AUTOMATED_RETRIEVAL (ToS effective 2024-08-06 prohibit automated queries/scripts; robots.txt disallows /deckpreview/; json.edhrec.com/robots.txt returns HTTP 403; historical snapshots only, no new automated fetches).
bias_risks: Popularity bias: deckbuilding presence != gameplay strength or winrate
Lift is relative deck co-occurrence, NOT winrate lift!
Echo-chamber bias: popular precons and internet lists dominate builder selections
sources.status_rationale: Data quality VERIFIED for 20 SHA-256-verified historical snapshots from 2026-11-11 (Run #43024442970, Refs #1186; 1,304 legacy rows remain retrieved_at_utc=NULL). Automated retrieval is separately classified access_status=prohibited per ToS (2024-08-06). Stock usable unchanged per Owner decision #1557 point 1; no new automated retrievals without the operator's written permission.

sources.title: Commander Spellbook Combo Variants (Bulk Export)
sources.schema_format: JSON Bulk (variants.json.gz) / JSON REST API (sparse only)
sources.coverage_scope: All known and rule-verified MTG combos matching Chulane color identity (Bant / WUG)
sources.double_counting_risk: Redundant combo variants (e.g. same loop with different bounce targets) must not be counted as independent strength claims.
sources.license_terms: MIT License (backend source code); combo dataset license unconfirmed on operator pages (attribution with link requested).
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Bulk GET via https://json.commanderspellbook.com/variants.json.gz (no full export via REST API; REST only for sparse unauthenticated requests at ~80 req/min respecting HTTP 429; backend.commanderspellbook.com/robots.txt disallows crawlers; strip price/salt fields).
bias_risks: Existence of a combo is NOT proof of consistency, speed, resilience or in-game winrate
Complex 4+ piece combos are rarely executed in real games
sources.status_rationale: Operator-recommended bulk export (variants.json.gz) for full combo data; REST API is sparse-only. Processed deterministically via scripts/spellbook_combos_fetch.py (bulk mode) and scripts/build_spellbook_shells.py.

sources.title: Curated Chulane 99-Card Deck Corpus (Repository Archive)
sources.publisher: Commander Studio repository archive (harvested from EDHREC and Archidekt)
sources.observation_period: Public Chulane decklists harvested from EDHREC (2,300 classified + 7,528 unclassified) and Archidekt (723); first capture date unbekannt, last refresh 2026-11-15 (corpus README, issue #1388); EDHREC retrievals 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-15 (#1557). Decks that left EDHREC's rolling two-year window stay in the corpus.
sources.coverage_scope: Canonical Chulane decklist corpus in repository (10,551 raw / 10,150 deduplicated decks; initial 975-deck ACTIVE archive superseded)
sources.double_counting_risk: Content duplicates resolved via canonical oracle_id fingerprint at import time.
sources.license_terms: Origin sources EDHREC (Terms of Service 2024-08-06) and Archidekt (Terms of Service 2018-09-07) both prohibit automated retrieval (register status prohibited); stock usable per Owner decision #1557 (point 1: keep using the EDHREC stock, no new automated retrievals without written permission; point 2: no Archidekt scraping). Purchase/price signals excluded for Chulane (AGENTS.md §12).
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: NO_NEW_HARVEST (origin sources prohibit automated retrieval, #1557). Stock is read from the repository by local import only (scripts/import_chulane_corpus.py).
bias_risks: Corpus reflects historical collection choices and specific community deck sources
Null-case trap: unobserved pool cards (0 hits) mean unobserved, never weak
sources.status_rationale: Canonical Chulane decklist corpus stored in-repo under data/research/chulane_corpus/ (replaces historical non-existent local:data/hub/ reference) and imported into studio.sqlite3. Bestand nutzbar nach Owner-Entscheid #1557 (Punkt 1: EDHREC-Bestand weiter nutzen, keine neuen automatisierten Abrufe ohne schriftliche Erlaubnis; Punkt 2: Archidekt kein Scraping), Herkunft verbotene Quellen, keine Nachernte. No retrieval timestamp or snapshot id is recorded for the corpus as a whole, so both stay None (unbekannt).

sources.title: cEDH Tournament Placement & Competitive Meta
sources.double_counting_risk: Same player entering sequential tournaments with minor card swaps.
sources.license_terms: EDHTop16 terms: API as-is, no excessive automated requests, no redistribution without permission, no documented rate limit; TopDeck.gg API v2 requires Owner API key, attribution with link, no scraping outside API, no storing player names.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: EDHTop16: unclear (no documented rate limit, no automated retrieval built); TopDeck.gg: API v2 only with an Owner key (5/50/100 req/min by tier, attribution required, omit player names). Owner decision #1557 point 3: no TopDeck API key is created while no cEDH reference is wanted, so no TopDeck retrieval (scripts/collect_topdeck_decks.py stays closed without a key).
bias_risks: Extreme selection bias: cEDH optimizes for turn 2-3 wins and fast mana incompatible with casual play
Very low sample size for Chulane in current competitive tier lists
sources.status_rationale: Valuable supplementary perspective, but requires manual audit due to cEDH selection divergence and undocumented EDHTop16 rate limits. No TopDeck data is collected (Owner decision #1557 point 3: no API key).

sources.title: XMage Engine Card Facts & Rules Support
sources.observation_period: XMage card repository export of 2026-11-12 (exported_at in data/cards/xmage_card_facts.json)
sources.coverage_scope: 32,615 cards in the XMage card repository export (card_count in data/cards/xmage_card_facts.json); has_xmage_rules 807 / 927 pool cards (gap matrix generated 2026-11-12)
sources.double_counting_risk: None; card names map deterministically to engine implementations.
bias_risks: Engine implementation coverage differs from full Oracle card universe
Tactical card mechanics without external decision control fail closed
sources.status_rationale: Local engine card facts export (32,615 cards, exported 2026-11-12). Pool coverage: has_xmage_rules 807 / 927 pool cards per the gap matrix of 2026-11-12; the other 120 are not covered. A per-card sim_status is not recorded in this register (unbekannt).

sources.title: Scryfall Tagger Functional Roles & Oracle Tags Bulk
sources.observation_period: Continuous community tag catalog (official Oracle Tags bulk)
sources.schema_format: JSONL Bulk (Scryfall Bulk oracle_tags, official bulk export)
sources.coverage_scope: Community functional tags: ramp, draw, removal, bounce, tutor, combo-piece
sources.double_counting_risk: Multiple overlapping tags for the same functional role (e.g. bounce-creature and bounce-permanent).
sources.license_terms: Scryfall API Terms: free non-commercial / research use with fan content attribution; official Oracle Tags bulk.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Bulk GET via Scryfall Bulk Data API (type: oracle_tags) with generic User-Agent and Accept headers; no AI training.
bias_risks: Community tags are subjective, non-authoritative annotations, not official MTG Oracle mechanics
Inconsistent granularity across card types
sources.status_rationale: Official Scryfall 'Oracle Tags' bulk export is accessible (access_status=ok_with_conditions, no longer blocked on license); data quality remains REVIEW due to community tag subjectivity.

sources.title: Archidekt Public Decklists
sources.observation_period: Historical Chulane bracket decklists in local corpus (723 decks)
sources.coverage_scope: Public Commander decklists with optional bracket metadata
sources.double_counting_risk: Decks indexed by Archidekt overlap with EDHREC decklists; deduplicate by canonical oracle_id fingerprint.
sources.license_terms: Archidekt Terms of Service (effective 2018-09-07): same wording as EDHREC; personal use only, automated queries and scripts prohibited; no public API documentation.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: PROHIBITED_AUTOMATED_RETRIEVAL (Terms of Service prohibit automated queries/scripts; no public API documentation).
bias_risks: Deckbuilding popularity != gameplay strength
Self-reported bracket tags may be inconsistent across authors
sources.status_rationale: No authorized automated retrieval path; Terms of Service (2018-09-07) prohibit automated queries with the same wording as EDHREC. Owner decision #1557 point 2: no scraping; the operator is asked, the rule-derived Game Changer band is the substitute.

sources.title: Moxfield Public Decklists
sources.coverage_scope: Not collected directly; API host disallowed
sources.double_counting_risk: Decks hosted on Moxfield overlap with EDHREC aggregations.
sources.license_terms: api2.moxfield.com/robots.txt disallows all paths (User-agent: * / Disallow: /); moxfield.com/terms returns HTTP 403 to automated clients.
bias_risks: Deckbuilding popularity != gameplay strength
Direct automated access blocked
sources.status_rationale: Automated access blocked: api2.moxfield.com/robots.txt disallows all paths for all user agents.

sources.title: Cardmarket Price Guide and Singles Product List (published downloads)
sources.observation_period: Daily file; only a local copy on the Owner's computer, never committed
sources.schema_format: JSON (priceGuides: idProduct, avg, low, trend and -foil fields)
sources.card_identifier: idProduct = cardmarket_id of the Scryfall printing
sources.coverage_scope: Only the TAM purchase list (#1637, register entry 'Preise für TAM'): lowest low and trend per card over its playable printings; never evidence, rating, tier list, ranking, suggestion or simulation input

game_context.commander: Tam, the Possibility (purchase list only; Chulane never)

sources.double_counting_risk: One price row per Cardmarket product; cards fold to oracle_id by minimum.
sources.license_terms: Terms for automated retrieval not read (UNBELEGT); the files are published for download by Cardmarket; robots.txt carries a reservation of rights (EU 2019/790). Owner exception 2026-11-22: the risk (e.g. a block) lies with the Owner.
sources.allowed_retrieval_method: Owner command only (import-cardmarket-priceguide): one GET per file, a local copy younger than 24 hours is reused, honest User-Agent, no cookies, account, key, proxy or redirect; any status other than 200 stops. No page of www.cardmarket.com is read (no scraping); values only in the local Studio store, never committed.
bias_risks: low and trend are not filtered by seller country or condition (no DE/EX)
low reflects one offer of any language or condition and swings on thin markets
sources.status_rationale: Owner exception 2026-11-22 (register entry 'Preise für TAM'): allowed for the TAM purchase list only, as a labelled approximation; access status stays unclear until the terms are read.
